_comment: Which source repository belongs to which company, so a reported defect can be
diagnosed and patched against real code. Copy to config/repos.json; that file is
gitignored because a private repo's URL can carry a token.
company      matched case-insensitively against the company a scan was run for.
url          clone URL. Cloned shallow and blobless on first use, into data/repos/.
path         an existing checkout to use instead of cloning. Takes precedence.
testCommand  only when it cannot be detected (pytest, npm test, cargo, go test).
Checkouts are read-only to this app: the fix runner copies one before touching it,
and nothing here ever commits or pushes.

repos._note: 203MB at depth 1. Diagnosis works; there is no test suite to verify a fix against.
Tracker is a Bugzilla, separate from the repo host — hence the explicit tracker.
